newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BANKS TO GET ACCESS TO RISKY INSTRUMENTS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BANKS TO GET ACCESS TO RISKY INSTRUMENTS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland, the central bank, plans to allow Polish banks to buy non-investment grade instruments this year, provided they create sufficient risk provisions, the NBP deputy head said.

"A relevant regulation is being prepared by our currency department...which would allow banks to invest in all instruments under the condition that they increase reserves," Krzysztof Barburski told a banking seminar on Friday.
"We want to implement it quickly, certainly by the end of the year," he added.
Polish banks are now allowed to buy debt issues of institutions with the highest credit ratings and treasuries of countries belonging to the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development.
